# Device and power source catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/catalog-docs.mjs from packages/runtime/src/catalog. Do not edit by hand. -->

The open catalog behind Outagekit: **5 devices** and **2 power sources**, last reviewed 2026-11-19. It is MIT licensed and ships as JSON in [`@outagekit/runtime`](../packages/runtime). Watts are average draw at the wall for each setting. ✅ means the figure was checked against a manufacturer document; other figures are typical values and the app tells people to check their own label.

Found a better figure? [Open a catalog correction](https://github.com/lobojoel2003/Outagekit/issues/new?template=catalog.yml).
